text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I understand. Thank you for bringing this
issue to
my attention. I'll reorder the
supplies right away.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's one more thing. It concerns
our
budget...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I just completed those documents
this
morning. I'll go and retrieve them
from the
student council office.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew... Onto the next task.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove is swamped with student
council work,
and this busy period is
showing no signs of letting
up.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm a little worried about her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've tried telling her to get some rest on
multiple
occasions, but she insists that
she's too busy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Like a change of pace? I can make that
happen!
I'll arrange a surprise that'll
whisk her off into a
realm of
astonishment and excitement!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, how should I go about this? I'd like
to hear
your input, if you've got the
time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Someone she'd listen to... Nice. I think
I've just
come up with a brilliant idea!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Okay, it's about time to head to
the
student council office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? Who is it?

Yoo-hoo, Air Groove! Have you been
well?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...What?! It can't be! That voice!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: M-Mother?! What are you doing here?
Oh, you know how it is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure I do! S-sorry, I just need a
couple of
minutes to clean up!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, not that the room is in any way
dirty—I just
want to tidy it up more!

...This vase looks natural over here,
right?!

Oh, don't you worry about any of that.
Just
listen—some of your friends told me
that you've
been running yourself
ragged recently.

That won't do at all. You've got to relax
more! Go
out and have fun with your
friends. You need a
change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All right, I will! And the room's ready
now, so we
can continue this
conversation inside! Let me
open the
door—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Surprise!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What?! Were you just imitating my
mother's
voice?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: How dare you? What could possibly have possessed you to do something so reprehensible?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Look, I'm sorry! I was just so worried about you! I had to do something.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Worried? About me?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everything I said just now when I was
pretending
to be your mother—it's how I
really feel.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Ahh, I see. So that's what this is all
about.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
While I disapprove of your methods... I
must
admit there is logic in your words.

That's right, Air Groove! Taking breaks is

absolutely crucial! How reassuring to
know that
you've such caring friends.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Not this again. And who is imitating my mother this time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kachak.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Air Groove! Your mother has
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wha—M-Mother?! Is it really you?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: SURPRISE!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, this won't do. You mustn't
exert yourself
so much that your friends
become concerned.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I want you to come home this weekend
and take
it easy. Come on, off we go!
You're long overdue
for a bit of letting
your hair down!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: W-wait! Mother?! Hold on a moment!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Flowers, huh? In that case... I might be
able to use
that gadget!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew... It's really getting late.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Hm? Are those flower seeds on my
table? I don't
recall having seeds like
those...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pop! Pop, pop, pop!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pop, pop! Pop! Pop, pop, pop!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What is that noise?! Wh-what's going
on?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh, what happened just now?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Groove?! You seem
awfully
flustered.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you, Fine... Hmm, how do I even
explain
this?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There was a series of small explosions in
our room
suddenly, and flowers started
blooming all over
the place.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Hehehe, that sounds like quite
the mire!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is no laughing matter... At any rate,
be sure
to stay alert—there could be
other bizarre
contraptions concealed
around here.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Your room was filled with
flowers?!
How terrible!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...What are you smirking about, dorm
leader? We
have to get to the bottom of
this quickly and
issue a report to—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait. You... Grrr, so that's what's going on!

text_block_list.name: Fuji & Fine
text_block_list.text: Surprise!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You had me completely fooled.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So how was the surprise? Did you enjoy
it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Enjoy it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We gathered all the flowers you like,
Groove!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You've been super busy lately, so we
hoped some
flowers would help alleviate
your stress!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Alleviate my stress, you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Ahh, I see... It's true that I've been
overworking
myself a little.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to put all the flowers in my
room into
vases... and you two are going
to help. Then we
can use them to
decorate the whole dorm.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, so you're going to end up
working
anyway. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That Empress of ours never learns, does
she?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but you're mistaken. I don't consider
this
work.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Putting flowers on display is how I relax.
